text:
incident-bot: ALERT: [P1] Detected multiple CUDA OOMs on us-west-2/render-03 serving pool. 22 OOMs in last 5m. Affected model: llm-prod-v3-quant. Headroom reports ~1.1GB but alloc failing to satisfy reserved blocks. See logs: <internal-monitoring-link>

sam: oncall here — paging @maria for allocator help, also pinging @elsa for infra

maria: i'm up. grabbing logs now. initial read: prefetch workers are firing large slab preallocs and then eviction loops cause paging thrash. allocator reports fragmentation; reserved-block claim fails even though headroom shows free. suspect interplay between KV-cache prefetch + reserve policy.

maria:
```
[serving] ERROR alloc.cc:492 allocate_reserved_block failed size=512MB id=0x7f9f... errno=12
nvml: out of memory; headroom_available=1.1GB reserved_total=1.6GB slabs_free=2
```

elsa: kube events show pod model-serving-112 OOMKilled at 13:14 UTC, several restarts, and kernel log has 'page allocation failure'. node render-03 has multiple container restarts and an nvml error during coredump write.

infra-bot: Automated mitigation: cordoned node render-03 and scaled up fallback pool serving-fallback-02 by 3 pods. Routing adjusted: 30% traffic to dedicated-fallback.

customer-success: CS: two enterprise customers (acme-inc, fintechco) reported 429s and elevated latency during 13:08-13:22 window. We opened support cases and notified account managers.

sam: proposed immediate mitigations from SRE/ML:
- disable prefetch for llm-prod-v3-quant on the cluster
- reduce reserve target from 1.6GB -> 0.5GB for that model variant
- trigger KV-cache eviction for model-serving-112 pods

maria: SGTM. commands i'll run:
```
# disable prefetch via config api (control plane)
curl -s -X POST 'https://controlplane.internal/api/models/llm-prod-v3-quant/override' -d 'prefetch_enabled=false'

# reduce reserve on nodes
kubectl -n serving exec cm-config -- sh -c 'apply-reserve --model llm-prod-v3-quant --target 512MB'

# evict kv cache on pods
kubectl -n serving exec deployment/model-serving -- /bin/sh -c 'echo evict > /tmp/kv-control'
```

sam: executing reduce-reserve now. will monitor OOM count

infra-bot: action executed: reserve updated for model llm-prod-v3-quant on nodes render-03/render-04, KV eviction command queued on 6 pods

maria: OOMs dropping — 0 in last 4m. latency moving toward baseline. core coredumps look incomplete but no new OOMKills. paging rate reduced after kv eviction and prefetch disabled.

devon: follow-ups: add guardrail to limit concurrent prefetch workers per node, add alert for reserve_total > headroom + 20%, and add a deployment-time check to avoid simultaneous prefetch + reserve growth for the same model.

sam: handing to maria for postmortem + remediation tickets. i'll remove cordon and let cluster rebalance in 10m. oncall handoff ends.

maria: noted. I'll file the postmortem and a config change request to default prefetch to off for high-reserve models. tagging @devon for follow-up.

sam: :thumbsup: thanks team — closing thread after postmortem posted.
